formula: each day every listed track is ranked against the rest of the market on what it is doing right now. 30% where it ranks for dj support gained in the last four weeks, 30% where it ranks for support gained this week, 10% where it ranks for all-time dj support, 20% its best beatport chart tier in the last two weeks, 10% spotify editorial adds in the last four weeks. a record djs stop adding sinks on its own and a record catching fire climbs fast. smoothed over a few days and scaled to 5-250 points. a track with no dj support yet is priced on its chart tier and editorial adds alone. heating up means the price rose 5% or more this week, cooling means it fell 5% or more.
